$comment: Bench targets: Oritech machines (CC0, github.com/Rearth/Oritech). The artist sees only the reference renders and the brief, never the source model.

foundry.brief: Oritech Foundry: an alloy furnace. Two ingot inputs are melted and combined; a heavy industrial block with side towers, a central blue heating core and a press on top.

assembler.brief: Oritech Assembler: combines several parts into a component. A workbench-like machine with a back wall, glowing work plates and an overhead gantry with a tool head.

centrifuge.brief: Oritech Centrifuge: separates materials by spinning. A base housing with a rotor carrying tanks that spin around a vertical axis.
